feed_title: Orthopaedic Memory Foam Dog Bed, Low Sided Oval, Small 61 x 51cm to Large 97 x 76cm, Waterproof Liner, Washable Cover | PawLunova Coniston
descriptionHtml:
61 to 97cm. Memory foam. Low enough to walk into.

Coniston is an oval memory foam orthopaedic dog bed with a low step-in edge, in Small 61 × 51cm, Medium 76 × 64cm and Large 97 × 76cm. A waterproof liner sits below the zipped cover.

Watch the moment before they get in. There is a pause, a calculation, then a lift of the front legs over the side. A deep-walled bed stopped being cosy and became one more climb.

An oval close to the floor takes the climb out. The rim stays, to lean against, but it is not a wall.

What they get

  • A memory foam core: Foam that holds its shape under nightly weight.
  • A low way in: An oval close to the floor, not a wall to climb.
  • A rim for their chin: Raised enough to lean on, not enough to trap.
  • A waterproof inner liner: Between cover and foam, so an accident never reaches it.

Best for: Dogs who hesitate before climbing in. Borrowdale closes all four sides. This one will not, for exactly that reason.

Why it is worth the money

The Large is £149. You pay for what cheap beds leave out: memory foam rather than filling, and a liner so one accident does not end it. A 5-year no-flatten guarantee sits on that core. Over 1825 nights, the five years it runs, that is about 8p a night, 7p on the £119 Medium.

You are not gambling the money either. Say so within 100 nights, we lift it off you free, and everything is refunded.

The trade-off, said plainly. A low side is a lower side to lean on. A dog who drapes a leg over a bolster wants Langdale.

Size and fit

SizeOutside (cm)
Small61 × 51
Medium76 × 64
Large97 × 76

Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. The rim sits inside these figures, so size up between sizes. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly which one fits.

Everyday care

Take the cover off at the zip and wash it to its care label. Dry fully before refitting. Never soak the foam.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide. 5 years on the foam.

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. The foam core also has a 5-year no-flatten guarantee under normal domestic use, subject to the guarantee terms; cover wear and pet damage are not included. Read the full returns and guarantee terms. This guarantee is in addition to your statutory rights and does not affect them.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

The questions we get asked most.

How do I choose the right size?

Side-on length plus 15 to 20cm, then round up.

When will it arrive?

Free over £40. The window shows at the basket.

Can I pay in instalments?

Yes. Options show at checkout.

How low is the step-in exactly?

We publish no step-in height and will not invent one.

Will it suit an older dog who finds it hard to get up?

We can only describe it. A memory foam core in a low oval. Ask your vet.

Can I actually wash it?

Yes. The zip runs round the cover and the label sets it.

Mine has ignored every bed so far.

It comes back too, collected free inside 100 nights.

Choose their size and take the climb out of going to bed.

facts_used: Coniston is an oval memory foam dog bed with a low resting profile, a raised rim for a chin and a waterproof inner liner under the zipped cover. Small (61 × 51cm), Medium (76 × 64cm) and Large (97 × 76cm).
**A memory foam core:** Foam that holds its shape under the weight it carries every night.
**A low way in:** An oval profile that sits close to the floor instead of a high wall to climb.
**A rim for their chin:** Raised just enough to lean on, not enough to get stuck behind.
**Protected underneath:** A waterproof inner liner sits between the cover and the foam, so an accident never reaches the core.
The foam core carries a 5-year no-flatten guarantee, and you have 100 nights to decide.
Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. These are outside measurements and the rim takes up part of that, so between sizes, size up.
Unzip the cover and wash it following the sewn-in care label. Air-dry fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.
Best for: Older dogs, stiff dogs and any dog who hesitates before climbing into their bed.
differentiation_note: The lowest way in: an oval that deliberately keeps its rim close to the floor, for the dog who has started pausing before stepping over an edge — where Borrowdale, Kendal and Helvellyn all ask them to climb.
